items.question: Since when has Petra Voss been General Counsel of Voss-Lindqvist?

items.question: Does the Calder & Wynne engagement cover advice on Swedish law?
items.answer:
The Calder & Wynne engagement letter specifies the scope of work. It states that the firm will advise Voss-Lindqvist AB on the renewal of its Master Services Agreement with Harrowgate Systems Inc. and review its mutual non-disclosure agreement with Northbridge Analytics Ltd. [4]

The engagement letter also clarifies that the work does not include advice on the laws of any jurisdiction other than England and Wales. [4]

Therefore, the documents indicate that the Calder & Wynne engagement does not cover advice on Swedish law. [4]

evidence.quote: We will advise Voss-Lindqvist AB on the renewal of its Master Services Agreement with Harrowgate Systems Inc. and review its mutual non-disclosure agreement with Northbridge Analytics Ltd.
Our work does not include tax advice or advice on the laws of any jurisdiction other than England and Wales.
